meta.title: Acme Notes UX elements catalog
meta.status: Starter example. Replace every value with your own product's.
meta.purpose: This catalog lists what a person reads and does on each page of Acme Notes, so layout and visual design start from an agreed list.
meta.main_message: Every page has one primary call to action, and it serves the visitor's main goal on that page.
meta.reading: Read the sitemap first, then each page from the top. Rows in an element table follow the page's reading order.
meta.tracking_note: Every interactive element sends the analytics event named in its row.

terms: A button or link that asks the person to take a step.
The one step a page exists to get. Each page has exactly one.
What a visitor wants on a page, written as "As a [role], I want to [goal]."
The steps a visitor takes toward a goal, each ending in the elements that meet it.
A button for something not built yet. The click says so and offers a real next step.
sources: Product plan (replace with your file name and section numbers).
Existing app code, if there is one.

open_questions.q: How many notes does the free plan allow?
open_questions.recommended: Unlimited notes on one device, so the first week has no limit to hit.

open_questions.q: The plan names no password rule.
open_questions.default: At least 8 characters, no other rules.
open_questions.reason: NIST SP 800-63B sets 8 characters as the minimum and advises against composition rules.
